Drafted in 1927 and declassified decades later, it was a contingency plan for a highly unlikely war. 这次进攻从未被认真考虑过。它起草于1927年，数十年后被解密，是针对一场极不可能发生的战争的应急预案。 History took the opposite path: In the century since, the United States and Canada have been two of the friendliest and most integrated nations ever to share a border. 历史走上了相反的道路：在此后一个世纪里，美国和加拿大成为了有史以来关系最为友好、融合程度最高的两个接壤国家。 Until recently, that is. 直到最近为止。 President Trump has thrown the U.S.-Canada relationship into its greatest crisis since his country’s northern neighbor became self-governing in 1867. Accusing Canada of unfair trade practices, Mr. Trump has instigated a trade war that on Tuesday led Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada to retaliate with tariffs targeting roughly $20 billion in U.S. imports. Mr. Trump in turn escalated with bans on imports of some Canadian motorcycles, alcoholic beverages, dairy products and molasses. 特朗普总统将美加关系推入自这个北方邻国1867年实现自治以来最严重的危机。特朗普指责加拿大采取不公平贸易做法，挑起了一场贸易战，这导致加拿大总理马克·卡尼于本周二 采取报复措施 ，对约200亿美元的美国进口商品加征关税。特朗普随后升级行动， 禁止 进口部分加拿大摩托车、酒精饮料、乳制品和糖蜜。 Mr. Trump is hardly the first U.S. president to feud with Canada, especially on economic matters. Trade disputes shook relations for much of the 20th century, though they became far less common once the 1994 North American Free Trade Agreement came into force. 特朗普远不是第一个与加拿大发生争执的美国总统，尤其是在经济问题上。贸易争端在20世纪大部分时间里动摇了两国关系，但在1994年《北美自由贸易协定》生效后，这类争端变得少得多。 Other heated cross-border disputes have flared on matters ranging from Alaska’s Yukon border to whether Canada would allow American nuclear weapons on its soil. 还有其他激烈的跨境争端，包括从阿拉斯加育空边界到加拿大是否允许美国核武器进入其领土等各种问题。 But Mr. Trump’s hostility toward Canada features a nationalist streak that goes well beyond economics. He has taunted its leaders as weaklings, denigrated its military as ineffective and even challenged its sovereignty. In particular, his talk of claiming its 3.9 million square miles of territory as a “51st state” has inflamed longtime Canadian anxieties about American domination, and even invasion. 但特朗普对加拿大的敌意带有一种远超出经济范畴的民族主义色彩。他嘲讽加拿大领导人软弱，贬低其军队无能，甚至质疑其主权。尤其是他声称要将加拿大998万平方公里的领土变为“第51个州”，这点燃了加拿大人长期以来对美国支配甚至入侵的担忧。 At times he even intimates violence, as in a recent Truth Social post depicting himself and Mr. Carney in hockey gear, with Mr. Trump standing over a fallen Mr. Carney as though he has just body-checked the Canadian leader. 有时他甚至暗示会诉诸暴力，比如他 最近在Truth Social上发布的一条帖子 ，描绘自己和卡尼穿着冰球装备，特朗普站在倒地的卡尼上方，仿佛刚刚对这位加拿大领导人进行了身体冲撞。 “I think it’s actually impossible to find a period where things were as bad,” said Robert Bothwell, a professor emeritus at the University of Toronto’s Munk School of Global Affairs who specializes in U.S.-Canada relations. “There’s never been an occasion, ever, where an American president has said the annexation of Canada was his objective.” “我认为实际上不太可能找到比现在更糟的时期，”多伦多大学蒙克全球事务学院专门研究美加关系的荣休教授罗伯特·博思韦尔说。“从来没有过，从来没有过美国总统说吞并加拿大是他的目标。” Before Mr. Trump came along, the popular American image of Canada was one of a friendly, harmless and perhaps somewhat dull junior partner to the United States. The notion of cross-border conflict was the stuff of satire. The 1995 Hollywood comedy “Canadian Bacon” imagined an unpopular U.S. president who whips up popular resentment toward Canada to distract from his domestic struggles. Now Canadians ask whether the movie was prescient . 在特朗普出现之前，美国人对加拿大的普遍印象是一个友好、无害、或许有些乏味的美国小伙伴。跨境冲突的想法是讽刺作品的素材。1995年的好莱坞喜剧《加拿大培根》(Canadian Bacon)设想了一位不受欢迎的美国总统，他煽动民众对加拿大的不满，以转移对国内困境的注意力。如今，加拿大人不禁要问，这部电影 是不是一种先见之明 ？ Canadians have always been warier of the United States, according to Christopher Sands, the director of the Center for U.S.-Canada Relations at Johns Hopkins University’s School of Advanced International Studies. 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学高级国际研究学院美加关系中心主任克里斯托弗·桑兹说，加拿大人一直对美国持更谨慎的态度。 Canada was formed by several British colonies that had never broken with London, unlike their American counterparts. Seeing the growth of U.S. economic and military power as a potential threat, they joined together in the name of collective strength while remaining part of the British Empire well into the 20th century. (War Plan Red did not reflect such a threat: It imagined a U.S. attack on Canada as a defensive response to war with Britain.) 加拿大由几个英国殖民地组成，与美国的殖民地不同，这些殖民地从未与伦敦决裂。它们将美国经济和军事实力的增长视为潜在威胁，于是以集体力量的名义联合起来，同时直到20世纪仍留在英帝国之内。（“红色战争计划”并未反映这种威胁：它设想美国对加拿大的攻击是对与英国开战的防御性回应。） Quarrels over a common 5,525-mile border were largely settled in a 1908 agreement, one that Mr. Trump has called invalid. 围绕两国8891公里边界的争端主要在1908年的一项协议中得到解决，特朗普曾称该协议无效。 But economics still roiled the relationship. After Congress approved a 1911 agreement to drop tariffs on major Canadian imports, conservatives in Canada attacked it as a threat to the country’s independence — not entirely without justification. 但经济仍然搅动着两国关系。1911年，美国国会批准了一项取消加拿大主要进口商品关税的协议后，加拿大的保守派抨击该协议威胁加拿大国家独立——这并非完全没有道理。 “I look forward to the time when the American flag will fly over every square foot of British North America up to the North Pole,” Representative Champ Clark, a Missouri Democrat who would soon become speaker, declared during a House debate on the measure. “我期待美国国旗飘扬在英属北美直到北极每一平方英尺的土地上，”密苏里州民主党众议员钱普·克拉克在众议院就该措施辩论时宣称。他不久后就成了众议院议长。 A backlash resulted in Canada. According to Mr. Bothwell, some Americans were stopped on the street and forced to sing “God Save the King.” 这在加拿大产生了强烈反弹。据博思韦尔说，一些美国人在街上被拦下，被逼着唱《天佑国王》。 Cold War politics produced more clashes. Canada fought alongside the United States in both world wars and joined the United States as a founding member of NATO. And President John F. Kennedy celebrated the relationship in a grandiloquent 1961 address to Canada’s parliament : “Those whom nature hath so joined together, let no man put asunder,” he declared. 冷战政治产生了更多冲突。加拿大在两次世界大战中与美国并肩作战，并作为创始成员与美国一起加入北约。 1961年 ，约翰·肯尼迪总统在加拿大议会发表了一篇气势恢宏的演讲，颂扬两国关系：“自然使其结合的，人力不可使其分离，”他宣称。 But Mr. Kennedy lashed out at Canada’s prime minister when he resisted the placement of certain U.S. nuclear weapons on Canadian soil that were intended to deter the Soviet Union, and when he hesitated to place Canada’s military on heightened alert during the Cuban Missile Crisis in 1962. 但加拿大总理抵制在加拿大领土上部署旨在威慑苏联的某些美国核武器，1962年古巴导弹危机期间，他又犹豫是否应让加拿大军队进入高度戒备状态，这两次，肯尼迪都猛烈抨击了这位总理。 An even greater shock came in the form of Richard Nixon’s 1971 move from the gold standard and imposition of 10 percent tariffs on all imports, including Canadian ones. While many countries were affected, none were quite so dependent on the U.S. economy as Canada. 更大的冲击来自理查德·尼克松1971年放弃金本位，并对包括加拿大在内的所有进口商品征收10%的关税。虽然许多国家受到影响，但没有哪个国家像加拿大那样依赖美国经济。 After a heated December 1971 meeting at the White House between Mr. Nixon and Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau, Mr. Nixon declared the Canadian a “pompous egghead” and a “son of a bitch.” Mr. Trudeau later responded that he had “been called worse things by better people.” 在1971年12月尼克松与皮埃尔·特鲁多总理在白宫的一次激烈会晤后，尼克松称这位加拿大人是“自命不凡的书呆子”和“混蛋”。特鲁多后来回应说，他“曾被更优秀的人骂过更难听的话”。 Mr. Nixon abandoned the plan months later. Mr. Sands said the economic disruption it created wound up driving support for greater free trade across the border, culminating in the 1994 NAFTA agreement. (Mr. Trump has derided that Clinton-era pact as a “nightmare,” and renegotiated it during his first term under the rubric of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, or U.S.M.C.A.) 尼克松几个月后放弃了该计划。桑兹说，该计划造成的经济动荡最终推动了跨境自由贸易的支持，最终促成了1994年的北美自由贸易协定。（特朗普嘲笑这个克林顿时代的协定是“噩梦”，并在第一个任期内以美墨加协定的名义对其进行重新谈判。） The shock of Mr. Nixon’s economic gambit also boosted Canadian mistrust of U.S. economic intentions. In 1973, the Canadian political thriller “Ultimatum” depicted an American president’s demand for free access to Canada’s vast oil and gas reserves. 尼克松经济赌注带来的冲击也加剧了加拿大对美国经济意图的不信任。1973年，加拿大政治惊悚小说《最后通牒》(Ultimatum)描绘了一位美国总统要求自由获取加拿大庞大石油和天然气储备的情节。 Canada’s prime minister resists, but the American president refuses to take no for an answer. 加拿大总理拒绝，但美国总统根本不肯接受拒绝。 “As of this moment, Canada will become part of the United States of America. The government of Canada is hereby dissolved,” he declares at its conclusion. “从此刻起，加拿大将成为美利坚合众国的一部分。加拿大政府就此解散，”他在影片结尾宣称。 “Ultimatum” became the year’s best-selling book in Canada. 《最后通牒》成为当年加拿大最畅销的书。 Few expect Mr. Trump to go that far. Mr. Sands said Mr. Carney could still strike a deal to defuse the crisis. But he also warned that the dispute had unleashed forces that may take on a life of their own. 很少有人预计特朗普会走到那一步。桑兹说，卡尼仍可能达成协议以化解危机。但他也警告说，这场争端已经释放出一些力量，这些力量可能会发展出自己的生命力。 “Trump has pushed the nationalist buttons in Canada,” Mr. Sands said. “As long as Carney resists, it’s good for his politics.” “特朗普按下了加拿大的民族主义按钮，”桑兹说。“只要卡尼抵制，对他的政治前途就有好处。” “The Canadians have really been shocked by this,” he added. To restore relations, he said, “we have to win the Canadian public back over — and that’s going to take a long time.” “加拿大人确实对此感到震惊，”他还说。他说，要恢复关系，“我们必须重新赢得加拿大公众的好感——而这需要很长时间。” Michael Crowley 是时报报道美国国务院和外交政策的记者。他曾在近三十个国家进行报道，并经常随国务卿出访。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 10小时60条社交媒体动态：特朗普的“现实”世界
description: PETER BAKER2026年9月10日7月4日美国国庆日活动期间，特朗普在使用手机。发布数十条关于自己和对手的表情包及AI生成图像已成为他第二个任期的标志性特征。 Al Drago for The New York Times Just before noon on a holiday weekend, while many Americans were at the beach, President Trump’s social media account roared to life. In what has increasingly become his weekend habit, he unleashed a daylong barrage of posts that put the bully in the modern bully pulpit. 在一个假期周末临近中午时分，当许多美国人还在海滩上时，特朗普总统的社交媒体账号突然活跃起来。这已越来越成为他周末的习惯——持续一整天的密集发帖，把总统的舆论平台变成了霸凌现场。 There were images of Mr. Trump intimidating Canada’s prime minister with a hockey stick, personally bombing enemy targets and patrolling dark streets with killer robots. There were maps showing the United States taking over other countries, and maps renaming a state. There were attacks on the “Dumocratic Party” and tributes to himself as “the Greatest President of All Time!” 特朗普发布了一些图片：里面有他手持冰球杆威吓加拿大总理，或者亲自轰炸敌方目标，或者与杀人机器人一起在漆黑的街道上巡逻的场景。还有显示美国吞并其他国家以及给某个州改名的地图。他还攻击“Dumocratic Party”（故意将民主党拼成蠢货党——译注），并发帖自夸“有史以来最伟大的总统”。 The 60 messages posted online over 10 hours and 41 minutes offered a window into Mr. Trump’s own unique reality, one anchored not in fact but in an expression of ego. For years, his social media feed was said to be a mirror of his id. But with A.I., it has become the manifestation of how he wants to be seen in a more visual, visceral way than ever before — as a warrior, as a conqueror, as a historical figure, as a younger and thinner and more muscular version of himself. 这60条信息在10小时41分钟内陆续发布，向人们展示了特朗普独特的现实世界——一个并非建立在事实而是建立在自我意识表达之上的世界。多年来，人们一直说他的社交媒体动态就像他本我的一面镜子。但借助人工智能，它比以往任何时候都更加直观、更加震撼地展现了他想要呈现的形象——一名战士、一名征服者、一位历史人物，以及一个更加年轻、更加瘦削、肌肉更加发达的自己。 In Mr. Trump’s digitally enhanced version of the world, he is a giant in every way, a man who defeats every adversary, overcomes every obstacle and sinks every putt. He not only redraws the map of the world but vanquishes the heavens themselves. “The Moon Is Ours,” declared one post last weekend with an image of the earth’s only satellite. Another posted a few weeks ago showed him leading an extraterrestrial alien in shackles. 在特朗普经过数字技术强化的世界里，他在方方面面都是一个巨人，是一个能够击败所有对手、克服所有障碍、每一杆推杆都能进洞的人。他不仅重新绘制世界地图，甚至还征服了整个苍穹。他上周末在一条帖子中配上一张地球唯一卫星的图片，宣称：“月球是我们的。”几周前的另一条帖子则显示，他牵着一个戴着镣铐的外星人。 The rat-a-tat of ever wilder, ever more outrageous posts each weekend has become a fixture of the president’s second term, seen more and more as a barometer of his mental state. Mr. Trump’s critics, who never considered him a model of stability in the first place, now point to these frenetic bursts of fantasy and vanity as proof that the 80-year-old president is deteriorating further with age. 每个周末越来越疯狂、越来越离谱的连番发帖已成为总统第二任期的固定节目，也越来越多地被视为衡量其精神状态的晴雨表。特朗普的批评者原本就不认为他是精神状态稳定的典范，如今更是把这些狂乱迸发的幻想和虚荣视为这位80岁总统随着年龄增长而进一步衰退的证据。 It is a measure of how much Mr. Trump has changed the nature of the presidency that any of this has become routine. Past presidents believed they had a duty to carry themselves with a certain dignity befitting the office. Mr. Trump sees politics like the cage match he sponsored this summer at the White House. 这些事情如今已经成为日常，恰恰说明特朗普在多大程度上改变了总统职位的性质。过去的总统认为，自己有责任以符合总统这一职位的某种庄重姿态行事。而特朗普看待政治的方式就像他今年夏天在白宫主办的那场笼斗比赛。 Indeed, the images he posted over the Labor Day weekend included one with his face on Hulk Hogan’s rippling body. Another posted a day later imagined a grinning Mr. Trump easily winning an arm wrestling match against Mr. Hogan, the flamboyant wrestling star who died last year. 事实上，他在劳动节周末发布的图片中，有一张把他的头像合成到胡克·霍根肌肉虬结的身体上。一天后的另一条帖子则想象了一个笑容满面的特朗普轻松赢得与霍根掰手腕——这位张扬的摔跤明星已于去年去世。 “He floods the zone with so much of it that we’ve become numb to just how bizarre it is,” said Sarah Matthews, Mr. Trump’s former deputy White House press secretary. “An 80-year-old president is spending a ridiculous amount of time consuming and reposting endless A.I. fan fiction portraying him as the biggest, strongest and most important person alive. It feels like we’re genuinely watching his brain rot in real time.” “他用这么多东西淹没信息场，以至于我们已经对这一切有多离奇变得麻木了，”特朗普的前副白宫新闻秘书萨拉·马修斯说。“一位80岁的总统正花费荒谬的时间去消费和转发无穷无尽的人工智能同人小说，把他描绘成活着的最高大、最强壮、最重要的人。感觉我们真的是正在看着他的脑子在我们眼前一点点腐烂。” To his defenders, Mr. Trump is a master of baiting his adversaries, getting them to react. “It’s called: We do a little trolling,” as Mr. Trump once put it. The more out there the message is, the more his supporters cheer. As abnormal as the images that he posts may be for a president, Mr. Trump’s allies argue that they convey a certain raw, earthy quality that suits an age of no-holds-barred politics. 对于那些为他辩护的人来说，特朗普是引诱对手上钩、让他们做出反应的大师。就像他自己曾说过的：“这叫：我们稍微逗逗他们。”内容越出格，他的支持者就越欢呼。尽管他发布的图片对一位总统来说可能很不寻常，但特朗普的盟友认为，它们传递出一种直白的、接地气的特质，恰好适合这个不受任何规则约束的政治时代。 “With all due respect, the media and President Trump’s other critics have spent more than a decade complaining about his use of social media,” said Alex Bruesewitz, a former campaign aide. “They keep calling it ‘unpresidential,’ but if the president is doing it, it is presidential by definition. I think most Americans appreciate the authentic and transparent way he uses these platforms.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​” “恕我直言，媒体以及其他批评特朗普的人，已经抱怨他使用社交媒体超过十年了，”特朗普前竞选团队助理亚历克斯·布鲁塞维茨说。“他们一直称这种做法‘不符合总统身份’，但如果总统在这么做，那么按照定义，这就是总统的行为。我认为，大多数美国人都欣赏他使用这些平台时所展现出的真实和透明。” Violence is a recurring theme in Mr. Trump’s feed. He relishes the idea of himself as a tough man staring down anyone who gets in his way. He smashes Iran with a giant hammer. He pilots a spacecraft blasting the planet. Most arresting was his post last weekend showing him in a hockey uniform with a stick towering over a fallen Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada and taunting, “Get up, Governor,” as if Canada really were the 51st state that he says he wants to make it. That one, unsurprisingly, further inflamed international tensions. 暴力是特朗普社交媒体动态中反复出现的主题。他热衷于把自己想象成一个硬汉，正面硬刚挡他路的人。他用一把巨锤砸向伊朗。他驾驶宇宙飞船轰炸地球。最令人注目的是他上周末发布的一张图片：他身穿冰球服，手持球杆，高高在上地俯视倒在地上的加拿大总理马克·卡尼，并嘲弄道：“起来，州长。”仿佛加拿大真的是他心心念念的第51个州。毫不意外，这条帖子进一步加剧了国家间的紧张关系。 特朗普经常发布图片，把自己塑造成怒视对手的的硬汉。 Alex Kent/The New York Times As Mr. Trump surely knew it would. It is hard to imagine any other president picturing himself physically assaulting the leader of an ally. But for Mr. Trump, who has been unable to force Mr. Carney to back down in a tariff fight, the cartoonish image allows him to present himself as winning even when he is not. 特朗普当然知道它会产生这样的效果。很难想象还有哪位总统会想象自己对一个盟友领导人动粗。但对于在关税争端中始终无法迫使卡尼让步的特朗普来说，这种漫画式的形象让他即使处于劣势也能把自己塑造成胜利者。 Never mind that he may cry foul if anyone else were to picture him as the target of violence. Goaded by Mr. Trump, the Justice Department indicted James B. Comey, the former F.B.I. director, for a social media post showing seashells spelling out the numbers “86 47,” interpreting the image as a threat to the president. 但如果别人把他描绘成暴力目标，他可能会大喊不公。在特朗普的鼓动下，司法部起诉了前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米，原因是后者在社交媒体上发了一条帖子，上面用贝壳拼出数字“86 47”，司法部将其解读为对总统的威胁。 “This is truly unhinged behavior from the President of the United States,” Representative Chellie Pingree, a Maine Democrat, wrote online after the Carney post. “And I don’t want to hear ‘oh, it’s just Trump being Trump’ or that he’s ‘trolling.’ Enough. None of this is normal or okay. Republicans cannot keep shrugging this off. Congress, the Cabinet, and everyone around him has a responsibility to stop enabling this dangerous behavior and start asking whether he is fit to hold this office.” “美国总统做出这样的行为，实在是极度失控，”缅因州民主党籍众议员谢莉·平格里在特朗普发布的有关卡尼的帖子后写道。“我不想再听到什么‘哦，这就是特朗普，他一向如此’，或者说他只是在‘引对手上钩’。够了。这一切都不正常，也没有一件是可以接受的。共和党人不能再继续对此耸耸肩、置之不理。国会、内阁以及他身边的所有人都有责任停止纵容这种危险的行为，并开始认真思考：他是否还适合担任这一职务。” The White House shrugged off the criticism. “Truth Social is the most powerful and popular social media platform in the world because it serves as President Trump’s authentic voice, where he communicates directly with the American people and the world without the biased media taking him out of context,” Davis Ingle, a White House spokesman, said in a statement, using the name of the president’s social media platform. 白宫对批评不以为意。“Truth Social是世界上最强大、最受欢迎的社交媒体平台，因为它是特朗普总统真实的声音，他在这里直接与美国人民和世界沟通，而不受带有偏见的媒体断章取义的影响，”白宫发言人戴维斯·英格尔在一份声明中说。 In fact, by traditional measures, Truth Social is nowhere near as popular as major social media platforms like Facebook or X and its traffic has slumped since last year. But it has effectively become the town hall for Mr. Trump’s MAGA followers and therefore plays an outsize role in American politics. Either posting himself or approving posts crafted by aides, Mr. Trump uses it as his main outlet for presidential messages to the world. 事实上，按传统标准衡量，Truth Social远不及Facebook或X等主要社交媒体平台受欢迎，其流量自去年以来也大幅下滑。但它实际上已成为特朗普MAGA追随者的市政厅，因此在美国政治中扮演着超乎寻常的角色。无论是自己发帖还是批准助手起草的帖子，特朗普都将其作为向世界传递总统信息的主要渠道。 Last Sunday was a striking day on Truth Social but increasingly typical of the president’s weekend blitzes, when he has fewer staff members around him and more unscheduled time. While at his golf club in Bedminster, N.J., Mr. Trump started posting at 11:54 a.m. and kept returning to his account in staccato bursts throughout the day. At 1:47 p.m., he posted six messages within two minutes. From 2:40 p.m. to 3:43 p.m., he circulated another 27 posts. He continued through the evening, only letting up after his final one of the night at 10:35 p.m. 上周日，Truth Social上的活动异常频繁，但这越来越符合总统的周末突击作风——周末他身边的工作人员较少，空闲时间也更多。在新泽西州贝德明斯特的高尔夫俱乐部，特朗普从上午11点54分开始发帖，一整天都断断续续地频繁更新。下午1点47分，他在两分钟内发布了六条消息。从下午2点40分到3点43分，他又转发了27条。他持续到晚上，直到晚上10点35分发出最后一条后才停歇。 特朗普有时会利用社交媒体发帖绕开传统媒体。 They were the kinds of posts that are common on the internet, just not normally from a head of state — impertinent, insulting, scornful, belligerent and sometimes out-and-out wacky. They offered a Rorschach test for followers, funny to those who admire what they see as Mr. Trump’s wry sense of humor, delusional to those who think he has lost his mind. 这些帖子是互联网上司空见惯的那种，只不过通常不会来自一位国家元首——无礼、侮辱、轻蔑、好斗，有时完全荒诞。它们为追随者提供了一场罗夏测试：对欣赏特朗普那种挖苦的幽默的人来说很好笑，对认为他已失去理智的人来说则是妄想。 While Mr. Trump’s posts regularly influence domestic politics and foreign policy, he also uses A.I. to promote grandiose visions of himself as a superhero, a pope and at one point last spring a Jesus-like figure. Last weekend’s posts included one that he has circulated before offering his own chart ranking American presidents, with him, naturally, at the top as “The Greatest.” Another post asserted: “He Will Go Down In History As the Greatest President of All Time!” 虽然特朗普的帖子经常影响国内政治和外交政策，但他也用人工智能来宣扬自己是超级英雄、教皇，以及去年春天某个时刻甚至是耶稣式人物的宏大幻象。上周末的帖子中有一条他之前也发过，提供了他自己的美国总统排名图表，自然把自己列为榜首“最伟大”。另一条断言：“他将作为有史以来最伟大的总统载入史册！” Mr. Trump, who avoided the draft during the Vietnam War with a diagnosis of bone spurs provided by a doctor who was one of his father’s tenants, particularly enjoys presenting himself as a martial hero. 特朗普在越战期间凭借医生（他父亲的租户之一）出具的骨刺诊断躲过了征兵，他特别喜欢把自己塑造成战斗英雄。 In an image posted last month, Mr. Trump wore the military uniform that he never wore in real life standing between Generals George S. Patton and Douglas MacArthur. George Washington has become a regular guest in Mr. Trump’s world lately. Sunday’s burst included images of him with the father of the country on horseback and in the Oval Office. 在上个月发布的一张图片中，特朗普穿着他在现实生活中从未穿过的军装，站在乔治·巴顿将军和道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军之间。乔治·华盛顿近来已成为特朗普世界的常客。周日的连番发帖中包括他与这位国父一起骑马以及在椭圆形办公室的图片。 The advent of A.I. has allowed Mr. Trump to go further than the mainly written social media posts of his first term. “Trump has always treated social media as a window into whatever he is thinking at that moment, but A.I. makes that window far more vivid and frankly more disturbing,” said Ms. Matthews, his former press aide. “And it feels like the more difficult reality gets for him, the more A.I. slop he posts.” 人工智能的出现让特朗普比第一任期时主要以文字为主的社交媒体帖子走得更远。“特朗普一直把社交媒体当作了解他当时想法的窗口，但人工智能让这个窗口更加生动，坦率地说也更令人不安，”他的前新闻助理马修斯说。“而且感觉对他来说现实越艰难，他发的人工智能垃圾就越多。” 今年1月，一场反对特朗普接管格陵兰计划的抗议活动。 Mr. Bruesewitz, the former campaign aide, called Mr. Trump an innovator who is paving the way to the future of politics. “President Trump is the first true social media president,” he said. “He has always adapted to the times, using new technology and platforms to take his message straight to the public. His A.I. posts generate enormous attention whenever he hits send.” 前竞选助手布鲁塞维茨称特朗普是一位创新者，正在为政治的未来铺路。“特朗普总统是第一位真正的社交媒体总统，”他说。“他一直适应时代，利用新技术和平台把信息直接传达给公众。他的AI帖子每次一发出就引发巨大关注。” No one would debate that they are attention generators. One way or another, that seems to be the point. 没有人会否认它们很能引来关注。说到底，这似乎正是重点所在。 Peter Baker是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。
content: PETER BAKER 2026年9月10日 7月4日美国国庆日活动期间，特朗普在使用手机。发布数十条关于自己和对手的表情包及AI生成图像已成为他第二个任期的标志性特征。 Al Drago for The New York Times Just before noon on a holiday weekend, while many Americans were at the beach, President Trump’s social media account roared to life. In what has increasingly become his weekend habit, he unleashed a daylong barrage of posts that put the bully in the modern bully pulpit. 在一个假期周末临近中午时分，当许多美国人还在海滩上时，特朗普总统的社交媒体账号突然活跃起来。这已越来越成为他周末的习惯——持续一整天的密集发帖，把总统的舆论平台变成了霸凌现场。 There were images of Mr. Trump intimidating Canada’s prime minister with a hockey stick, personally bombing enemy targets and patrolling dark streets with killer robots. There were maps showing the United States taking over other countries, and maps renaming a state. There were attacks on the “Dumocratic Party” and tributes to himself as “the Greatest President of All Time!” 特朗普发布了一些图片：里面有他手持冰球杆威吓加拿大总理，或者亲自轰炸敌方目标，或者与杀人机器人一起在漆黑的街道上巡逻的场景。还有显示美国吞并其他国家以及给某个州改名的地图。他还攻击“Dumocratic Party”（故意将民主党拼成蠢货党——译注），并发帖自夸“有史以来最伟大的总统”。 The 60 messages posted online over 10 hours and 41 minutes offered a window into Mr. Trump’s own unique reality, one anchored not in fact but in an expression of ego. For years, his social media feed was said to be a mirror of his id. But with A.I., it has become the manifestation of how he wants to be seen in a more visual, visceral way than ever before — as a warrior, as a conqueror, as a historical figure, as a younger and thinner and more muscular version of himself. 这60条信息在10小时41分钟内陆续发布，向人们展示了特朗普独特的现实世界——一个并非建立在事实而是建立在自我意识表达之上的世界。多年来，人们一直说他的社交媒体动态就像他本我的一面镜子。但借助人工智能，它比以往任何时候都更加直观、更加震撼地展现了他想要呈现的形象——一名战士、一名征服者、一位历史人物，以及一个更加年轻、更加瘦削、肌肉更加发达的自己。 In Mr. Trump’s digitally enhanced version of the world, he is a giant in every way, a man who defeats every adversary, overcomes every obstacle and sinks every putt. He not only redraws the map of the world but vanquishes the heavens themselves. “The Moon Is Ours,” declared one post last weekend with an image of the earth’s only satellite. Another posted a few weeks ago showed him leading an extraterrestrial alien in shackles . 在特朗普经过数字技术强化的世界里，他在方方面面都是一个巨人，是一个能够击败所有对手、克服所有障碍、每一杆推杆都能进洞的人。他不仅重新绘制世界地图，甚至还征服了整个苍穹。他上周末在一条帖子中配上一张地球唯一卫星的图片，宣称：“ 月球是我们的 。”几周前的另一条帖子则显示，他牵着 一个戴着镣铐的外星人 。 The rat-a-tat of ever wilder, ever more outrageous posts each weekend has become a fixture of the president’s second term, seen more and more as a barometer of his mental state. Mr. Trump’s critics, who never considered him a model of stability in the first place, now point to these frenetic bursts of fantasy and vanity as proof that the 80-year-old president is deteriorating further with age . 每个周末越来越疯狂、越来越离谱的连番发帖已成为总统第二任期的固定节目，也越来越多地被视为衡量其精神状态的晴雨表。特朗普的批评者原本就不认为他是精神状态稳定的典范，如今更是把这些狂乱迸发的幻想和虚荣视为这位80岁总统 随着年龄增长而进一步衰退 的证据。 It is a measure of how much Mr. Trump has changed the nature of the presidency that any of this has become routine. Past presidents believed they had a duty to carry themselves with a certain dignity befitting the office. Mr. Trump sees politics like the cage match he sponsored this summer at the White House. 这些事情如今已经成为日常，恰恰说明特朗普在多大程度上改变了总统职位的性质。过去的总统认为，自己有责任以符合总统这一职位的某种庄重姿态行事。而特朗普看待政治的方式就像他今年夏天在白宫主办的那场笼斗比赛。 Indeed, the images he posted over the Labor Day weekend included one with his face on Hulk Hogan’s rippling body . Another posted a day later imagined a grinning Mr. Trump easily winning an arm wrestling match against Mr. Hogan, the flamboyant wrestling star who died last year . 事实上，他在劳动节周末发布的图片中，有一张把他的头像合成到 胡克·霍根肌肉虬结的身体 上。一天后的另一条帖子则想象了一个笑容满面的特朗普轻松赢得与霍根 掰手腕 ——这位张扬的摔跤明星已于 去年去世 。 “He floods the zone with so much of it that we’ve become numb to just how bizarre it is,” said Sarah Matthews, Mr. Trump’s former deputy White House press secretary. “An 80-year-old president is spending a ridiculous amount of time consuming and reposting endless A.I. fan fiction portraying him as the biggest, strongest and most important person alive. It feels like we’re genuinely watching his brain rot in real time.” “他用这么多东西淹没信息场，以至于我们已经对这一切有多离奇变得麻木了，”特朗普的前副白宫新闻秘书萨拉·马修斯说。“一位80岁的总统正花费荒谬的时间去消费和转发无穷无尽的人工智能同人小说，把他描绘成活着的最高大、最强壮、最重要的人。感觉我们真的是正在看着他的脑子在我们眼前一点点腐烂。” To his defenders, Mr. Trump is a master of baiting his adversaries, getting them to react. “It’s called: We do a little trolling,” as Mr. Trump once put it. I think most Americans appreciate the authentic and transparent way he uses these platforms.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​” “恕我直言，媒体以及其他批评特朗普的人，已经抱怨他使用社交媒体超过十年了，”特朗普前竞选团队助理亚历克斯·布鲁塞维茨说。“他们一直称这种做法‘不符合总统身份’，但如果总统在这么做，那么按照定义，这就是总统的行为。我认为，大多数美国人都欣赏他使用这些平台时所展现出的真实和透明。” Violence is a recurring theme in Mr. Trump’s feed. Most arresting was his post last weekend showing him in a hockey uniform with a stick towering over a fallen Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada and taunting, “Get up, Governor,” as if Canada really were the 51st state that he says he wants to make it. That one, unsurprisingly, further inflamed international tensions. 暴力是特朗普社交媒体动态中反复出现的主题。他热衷于把自己想象成一个硬汉，正面硬刚挡他路的人。他用一把巨锤 砸向伊朗 。他驾驶宇宙飞船 轰炸地球 。最令人注目的是他上周末发布的一张图片：他身穿冰球服，手持球杆，高高在上地俯视倒在地上的加拿大总理马克·卡尼，并嘲弄道：“ 起来，州长 。”仿佛加拿大真的是他心心念念的第51个州。毫不意外，这条帖子进一步加剧了 国家间的紧张关系 。 特朗普经常发布图片，把自己塑造成怒视对手的的硬汉。 Alex Kent/The New York Times As Mr. Trump surely knew it would. It is hard to imagine any other president picturing himself physically assaulting the leader of an ally. But for Mr. Trump, who has been unable to force Mr. Carney to back down in a tariff fight, the cartoonish image allows him to present himself as winning even when he is not. 特朗普当然知道它会产生这样的效果。很难想象还有哪位总统会想象自己对一个盟友领导人动粗。但对于在关税争端中始终无法迫使卡尼让步的特朗普来说，这种漫画式的形象让他即使处于劣势也能把自己塑造成胜利者。 Never mind that he may cry foul if anyone else were to picture him as the target of violence. They offered a Rorschach test for followers, funny to those who admire what they see as Mr. Trump’s wry sense of humor, delusional to those who think he has lost his mind. 这些帖子是互联网上司空见惯的那种，只不过通常不会来自一位国家元首——无礼、侮辱、轻蔑、好斗，有时完全荒诞。它们为追随者提供了一场罗夏测试：对欣赏特朗普那种挖苦的幽默的人来说很好笑，对认为他已失去理智的人来说则是妄想。 While Mr. Trump’s posts regularly influence domestic politics and foreign policy, he also uses A.I. to promote grandiose visions of himself as a superhero, a pope and at one point last spring a Jesus-like figure . Last weekend’s posts included one that he has circulated before offering his own chart ranking American presidents , with him, naturally, at the top as “The Greatest.” Another post asserted : “He Will Go Down In History As the Greatest President of All Time!” 虽然特朗普的帖子经常影响国内政治和外交政策，但他也用人工智能来宣扬自己是超级英雄、教皇，以及去年春天某个时刻甚至是 耶稣式人物 的 宏大幻象 。上周末的帖子中有一条他之前也发过，提供了他自己的 美国总统排名图表 ，自然把自己列为榜首“最伟大”。另一条 断言 ：“他将作为有史以来最伟大的总统载入史册！” Mr. Trump, who avoided the draft during the Vietnam War with a diagnosis of bone spurs provided by a doctor who was one of his father’s tenants, particularly enjoys presenting himself as a martial hero. 特朗普在越战期间凭借医生（他父亲的租户之一）出具的骨刺诊断躲过了征兵，他特别喜欢把自己塑造成战斗英雄。 In an image posted last month, Mr. Trump wore the military uniform that he never wore in real life standing between Generals George S. Patton and Douglas MacArthur. George Washington has become a regular guest in Mr. Trump’s world lately. Sunday’s burst included images of him with the father of the country on horseback and in the Oval Office . 在上个月发布的一张图片中，特朗普穿着他在现实生活中从未穿过的军装，站在乔治·巴顿将军和道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军之间。乔治·华盛顿近来已成为特朗普世界的常客。周日的连番发帖中包括他与这位国父 一起骑马 以及 在椭圆形办公室 的图片。 The advent of A.I. has allowed Mr. Trump to go further than the mainly written social media posts of his first term. “Trump has always treated social media as a window into whatever he is thinking at that moment, but A.I. makes that window far more vivid and frankly more disturbing,” said Ms. Matthews, his former press aide. “And it feels like the more difficult reality gets for him, the more A.I. slop he posts.” 人工智能的出现让特朗普比第一任期时主要以文字为主的社交媒体帖子走得更远。“特朗普一直把社交媒体当作了解他当时想法的窗口，但人工智能让这个窗口更加生动，坦率地说也更令人不安，”他的前新闻助理马修斯说。“而且感觉对他来说现实越艰难，他发的人工智能垃圾就越多。” 今年1月，一场反对特朗普接管格陵兰计划的抗议活动。 Mr. Bruesewitz, the former campaign aide, called Mr. Trump an innovator who is paving the way to the future of politics. “President Trump is the first true social media president,” he said. “He has always adapted to the times, using new technology and platforms to take his message straight to the public. His A.I. posts generate enormous attention whenever he hits send.” 前竞选助手布鲁塞维茨称特朗普是一位创新者，正在为政治的未来铺路。“特朗普总统是第一位真正的社交媒体总统，”他说。“他一直适应时代，利用新技术和平台把信息直接传达给公众。他的AI帖子每次一发出就引发巨大关注。” No one would debate that they are attention generators. One way or another, that seems to be the point. 没有人会否认它们很能引来关注。说到底，这似乎正是重点所在。 Peter Baker 是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

title: AI可能消灭人类？Anthropic研究人员警告行业发展过速
description: KATE CONGER2026年9月10日Anthropic旧金山办公室外的抗议活动。 Lucas Foglia for The New York Times For years, the artificial intelligence industry raced to improve its technology as quickly as possible. Now some researchers are increasingly sounding the alarm about the need to slow down. 多年来，人工智能行业竞相以最快速度改进其技术。如今，一些研究人员正日益就放慢速度的必要性发出警告。 Jacob Coxon, an Anthropic researcher who previously worked at OpenAI, said on Tuesday that he had resigned from Anthropic because “neither company is acting responsibly.” The two leading A.I. labs are sprinting to build “superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionize any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources” without building in appropriate safeguards, he said in a social media post. 曾任职于OpenAI的Anthropic研究人员雅各布·考克森周二表示，他已从Anthropic辞职，因为“两家公司都没有负责任地行事”。他在一则社交媒体帖子中说道，这两家领先的人工智能实验室正在急切地构建“能够侵入任何地方、一夜之间彻底改变任何领域、并获取真正权力和资源的超人系统”，却没有内置适当的保障措施。 Mr. Coxon’s warning echoed concerns that other A.I. experts have voiced in recent months. Some A.I. leaders have long believed that the technology could create doomsday scenarios if left unchecked, and their concerns heightened after OpenAI’s models broke out of its systems in July and hacked Hugging Face, an A.I. model library. 考克森的警告呼应了其他人工智能专家近几个月表达的担忧。一些人工智能领导人长期以来一直认为，如果放任不管，这项技术可能制造末日情景。在OpenAI的模型于7月突破其系统并入侵Hugging Face（一个人工智能模型库）之后，他们的担忧加剧了。 That same month, more than 1,300 employees at top A.I. companies, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta and Google’s DeepMind, signed an open letter calling on the U.S. government to create rules to slow A.I. development. In August, more than 100 major tech companies committed to providing their best A.I. models to organizations like hospitals and infrastructure providers so they could prepare for A.I.-powered cyberattacks. 同月，包括Anthropic、OpenAI、Meta和谷歌DeepMind在内的顶级人工智能公司的1300多名员工签署了一封公开信，呼吁美国政府制定规则以放慢人工智能发展。8月，超过100家大型科技公司承诺向医院和基础设施提供商等组织提供其最好的人工智能模型，以便它们能够为人工智能驱动的网络攻击做好准备。 OpenAI also said last month that it would expand safety testing and slow the release of a new model, Astra, which has powerful cybersecurity abilities. OpenAI上个月还表示，将扩大安全测试，并延缓新模型Astra的发布，该模型具有强大的网络安全能力。 In an interview on Wednesday, Mr. Coxon said incidents like the Hugging Face hack had heightened his concerns that A.I. models were advancing too quickly. When he looked a year or two ahead, he was “viscerally worried about what things will look like,” Mr. Coxon said. “It was mostly a gradual emotional thing and eventually it kind of snapped, and then I decided to leave.” 考克森周三接受采访时表示，像Hugging Face被入侵这样的事件加剧了他的担忧，即人工智能模型推进得太快。当他展望一两年后，他“发自内心地担心事情会变成什么样”，考克森说。“这主要是一个逐渐累积的情绪过程，最终有点像是崩了，于是我决定离开。” Some critics have argued that A.I. companies are overhyping the technology to make their products appear more valuable. Several lawmakers said on Wednesday, however, that they were taking Mr. Coxon’s warning seriously. 一些批评者认为，人工智能公司夸大了这项技术，以使其产品显得更有价值。然而，几位议员周三表示，他们正在认真对待考克森的警告。 “There are massive implications of a race towards super intelligence,” Representative Anna Paulina Luna of Florida, a Republican, wrote in a social media post in which she called on Congress to convene a special session focused on A.I. regulation. “Not enough of Congress is focusing on this.” “急切奔向超级智能会带来深远的后果，”佛罗里达州共和党众议员安娜·保利娜·卢纳在一则社交媒体帖子中写道，她在帖子中呼吁国会召开一次专注于人工智能监管的特别会议。“国会对此关注得不够。” “Safety researchers are resigning, powerful A.I. models are breaking out of their labs, and companies are racing ahead anyway,” Representative Lori Trahan of Massachusetts, a Democrat, wrote in a social media post. “It’s past time for Congress to get off the sidelines and do its job.” “安全研究员正在辞职，强大的人工智能模型正在突破其实验室，而企业仍然不管不顾地竞相前进，”马萨诸塞州民主党众议员洛里·特拉汉在社交媒体发帖写道。“国会早就该停止袖手旁观，开始做好自己的分内事了。” While leading A.I. labs have agreed that the government should place restrictions on the pace at which the technology is developed and released to the public, many companies are fiercely competing with one another and fear falling behind their rivals if they pause. 尽管领先的人工智能实验室一致认为，政府应该对这项技术开发和向公众发布的速度施加限制，但许多公司正在激烈竞逐，并担心一旦停下来就会落后于对手。 “They are locked in a race to get there first — they believe no one else will act responsibly, so they must do it themselves, despite the risk,” Mr. Coxon said in his social media post. “他们陷入了一场争当第一的竞赛——他们相信没有谁会负责任地行事，所以他们必须自己来做，尽管有风险，”考克森在他的社交媒体帖子中说道。 At least one Anthropic employee agreed with Mr. Coxon’s assessment. 至少有一名Anthropic员工同意考克森的评估。 “We really do earnestly believe A.I. could kill all humans!” Evan Hubinger, who works at Anthropic on creating A.I. that aligns with human ethics and values, wrote on social media. Mr. Hubinger said he believed the risk of A.I.’s eliminating humanity was greater than 10 percent within the next decade. “我们确实真心相信人工智能可能杀死全人类！”埃文·胡宾格在社交媒体上写道，他在Anthropic工作，致力于创建与人类伦理和价值观对齐的人工智能。胡宾格表示，他相信人工智能消灭人类的风险在未来十年内超过10%。 “I believe Anthropic is trying its best, but we do not yet have a plan to solve alignment for superintelligence and are not clearly on track to,” he added. “我相信Anthropic正在尽力而为，但我们还没有解决超级智能对齐问题的计划，也没有找到明确的解决路径，”他补充道。 An Anthropic spokeswoman said on Wednesday that the company had long been transparent about the benefits and risks of A.I., and was building models with some of the strongest safeguards in the industry. 一位Anthropic发言人周三表示，该公司长期以来一直对人工智能的好处和风险保持透明，并且正在构建拥有业内最强保障措施的模型。 “We believe the world would benefit from the industry adopting a lawful, verifiable way to work together to pace how we release powerful models,” the spokeswoman said. “我们相信，如果整个行业采用一种合法、可验证的方式共同协作，来调节我们发布强大模型的速度，世界将从中受益，”这位发言人说。 OpenAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment about Mr. Coxon’s comments. Mr. Hubinger also did not immediately respond to a request for comment. OpenAI没有立即回应就考克森言论置评的请求。胡宾格也没有立即回应置评请求。 (The New York Times has sued OpenAI and Microsoft, claiming copyright infringement of news content related to A.I. systems. The two companies have denied those claims.) （《纽约时报》已起诉OpenAI和微软，主张其与人工智能系统相关的新闻内容存在版权侵权。两家公司否认这些指控。） Dylan Freedman对本文有报道贡献。 Kate Conger是一名科技记者，常驻旧金山。可以通过电子邮件kate.conger@nytimes.com联系她。 翻译：经雷 点击查看本文英文版。

title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output. ADHD-friendly outputs. No ADHD diagnosis needed! 🇬🇧 · 🇨🇳 · 🇧🇷 · 🇯🇵 · 🇻🇳 · 🇰🇷 · 🇹🇭 Install Copy/paste into your CLI prompt: Install the i-have-adhd skill/plugin from https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd, refer to the repo's AGENTS.md for instructions. Or 🔗 check the installation instructions. What it does A skill for your coding assistant that stops it from burying the answer. Action first. Steps numbered. No "Hope this helps!" What changes Before Great question! Let me think about this. Your auth flow has a few moving pieces: the middleware, the token verification, and the cookie handling. Looking at src/auth.ts, the verifyToken function (around lines 42-58) seems to be using an older jsonwebtoken API. One approach would be to update the package and rewrite that function. After making the change, you'd want to run the auth tests to confirm nothing breaks. By the way, you might also want to look at your dependency versions overall. Hope this helps! Let me know if you want to dig deeper. After Run npm install jsonwebtoken@latest, then edit src/auth.ts:42.
